site.title: NetRealm Arcade
site.tagline: Study games for networking, DevOps & automation

games.title: Uptime Empire
games.description: A datacentre tycoon from a 1995 garage to a hyperscale campus. Rack real-era Cisco, Juniper, HP/Aruba and Fortinet gear, sign customers and keep their SLAs - then troubleshoot real outages in faithful IOS, NX-OS, ASA, IOS XR, Junos, AOS-CX, AOS-Switch, ArubaOS and FortiOS command lines, write root-cause analyses and survive history's worst network days.

games.title: Packet Quest: The Great Outage
games.description: A retro RPG where every battle is a question. Fight through nine zones of CCNA / Network+ networking, Linux, Git & CI/CD, network automation, containers and IaC, with spaced repetition, a Codex, daily quests and a two-player Quiz Duel.
